messages:
leah-cs: Ok team, prepping Acme's Dedicated bring-up next week. Quick status: quota requested 48 GPUs, autoscale policy = Stepped (min 4 max 48). Load test window tentative Thu — need final check on warm cache priming and renewal risk notes.

sam-eng: We have the reservation approved, starts Mon 09:00 UTC. We'll kick off shadow priming Tue morning. Suggest a soft-start ramp instead of straight-to-full.

raj-devops: Can we confirm health probes, KV cache sizing, and that KMS rotation is scheduled before handoff? Also need node-level logging enabled for the smoke run.

olivia-se: I'll run a dry-run of the loadscript and validate 95p latency + error rates. @sam-eng can you add kv_hit_rate and token_cost_per_call to the service dashboard?

leah-cs: Also we need onboarding + enablement items: runbook checklist, support contacts, rollback playbook, and a short runbook for the customer's SREs. Draft doc link: https://redwood.internal/docs/acme-dedicated-onboard (placeholder).

sam-eng: Added kv_hit_rate and token_cost_per_call. For soft-start, propose: day1 10% traffic, day2 30%, day3 60%, day4 full. Will configure a canary route that falls back to the smaller model on overload.

raj-devops: deploy-bot, schedule a smoke deploy for the priming script on Tue 06:00 UTC. I'll verify KMS rotation by Friday.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: smoke-loadscript v1 -> staging at 2026-11-05T06:00:00Z :rocket: (will post logs in #eng-runtime)

karen-csm: Flag on renewal risk: Acme reiterated cost sensitivity in last call. Recommend we run quantization profiles (q8_4 / q4_0) on a read-only replica and capture quality diffs before month end. I'll own the customer cost discussion.

olivia-se: We'll run q8_4 on a replica and validate with their top prompts. @karen-csm can you paste their top ~20 prompts here so we can build the eval set?

karen-csm: Sharing prompts now (pasted into the doc). Also scheduling a feedback + enablement session with Acme Fri 16:00 PT — will send invite.

leah-cs: Action items: 1) sam -> add kv metrics + create canary route; 2) raj -> confirm KMS rotation + enable node logging + run smoke deploy; 3) olivia -> run dry-run, latency checks, quant eval; 4) karen -> run customer cost session and share prompt set. Anyone object or missing?

sam-eng: :thumbsup: no objections.

raj-devops: I'll confirm KMS rotation completed by Fri 03:00 UTC and post a brief checklist here.

deploy-bot: Reminder: loadtest window Thu 14:00-16:00 UTC — team ops on standby.

karen-csm: I'll send the enablement checklist + invite the customer to the Thursday load-observe window and Friday feedback call.

leah-cs: Great. If we hit a regression during quant eval, fallback plan is: disable the quant profile, revert canary to baseline model, and open a support ticket with model-team.

olivia-se: Noted. I'll post results to the doc and tag the model-team if quality drops.

leah-cs: Thanks everyone — will consolidate into a brief handoff email to Acme and ops later today.
